visuals.alt: A client sends identity, trust evidence, and a DPoP proof to Latchway, which applies security and feature policy, stores authoritative state in PostgreSQL, and calls an AI upstream with a server-held credential.

A client names a stable feature; Latchway applies trust, model-aware input preflight, quotas, and retry policy before selecting a weighted or sticky route and recording each permitted upstream attempt.
One application user has an Installation Family containing a directly attested main app and delegated widget and share components, each with an independent DPoP key and refresh chain.
An untrusted client presents an identity token, app or web trust evidence, and a fresh DPoP proof to separate Latchway verifiers before server-owned feature policy issues a bounded session.
